title: Phishing attack against personnel
threat: Targeted spear-phishing -- credential harvesting or malware delivery
description: Employees receive convincing phishing emails impersonating management or customers. Successful attack yields valid credentials or installs malware on corporate endpoint.
controls: MFA enforced, phishing simulation training, email filtering
planned_controls: FIDO2 hardware keys for privileged accounts, AI-based email threat detection

title: Supply chain compromise via third-party software
threat: Malicious code injected into software update from trusted supplier
description: A third-party supplier delivers a software update containing malicious code. Affects systems that apply the update automatically. Analogous to SolarWinds 2020 and XZ Utils 2024.
planned_controls: Mandatory SBOM for critical suppliers, staged rollout policy for updates, integrity verification

title: Ransomware affecting operational systems
asset: Critical IT infrastructure and operational data
threat: Ransomware deployment following initial access via phishing or exposed service
description: Attacker gains initial access, moves laterally, and deploys ransomware across operational systems. Could halt production and destroy backup data if not isolated quickly.
controls: Network segmentation, backup policy, EDR on endpoints
planned_controls: Immutable backups, tested recovery procedures, ransomware-specific playbook

title: Insider threat -- unauthorised data access
threat: Privileged employee deliberately or negligently exfiltrates sensitive data
description: Personnel with legitimate access to classified or sensitive information misuse that access. Could be intentional exfiltration or negligent handling leading to exposure.
controls: Need-to-know access control, authorisation management, background checks
planned_controls: User behaviour analytics (UBA), DLP solution, periodic access reviews

title: Weak endpoint security on remote workers
threat: Unmanaged or poorly secured endpoint used as entry point
description: Remote workers use laptops that may not have consistent patch levels, EDR coverage or disk encryption enforced. Increases the attack surface significantly.
controls: MDM enrolled devices, VPN required for corporate access
planned_controls: Full-disk encryption enforcement, automated patch compliance reporting

title: Missing security requirements in supplier contracts
asset: Supplier relationships and data shared with third parties
threat: Supplier without contractual security obligations suffers breach affecting our data
description: Contracts with some suppliers do not include explicit security requirements, data processing agreements or breach notification obligations. Creates legal and operational exposure.
controls: Some contracts include data processing agreements
planned_controls: Standard security clause library, supplier security self-assessment questionnaire, annual reviews

title: Inadequate logging and monitoring
threat: Attacker operates undetected due to insufficient log collection or alert coverage
description: Not all systems send logs to the central SIEM. Some alert rules are not tuned, generating noise that causes real alerts to be missed. Mean time to detect (MTTD) is unknown.
controls: SIEM in place, some alert rules active
planned_controls: Full log coverage audit, MITRE ATT&CK-mapped detection rules, MTTD measurement

title: Lost or stolen laptop -- no encryption
threat: Device physically lost or stolen, data accessible without encryption
description: A subset of older laptops does not have full-disk encryption enforced. If lost, any data stored locally is readable without credentials.
planned_controls: Enforce BitLocker via MDM policy, complete rollout Q2 2026
closed_note: BitLocker enforced on all devices as of 2026-04-01. Residual risk accepted.
